name: single-phase diode bridge with capacitor input
description: 100 V rms, 50 Hz source feeding a diode bridge with C = 1 mF and R = 100 ohm on the DC side (w*R*C = 31.4). With ideal elements the diodes stop conducting at 91.8 deg and start again at 66.5 deg after the next zero crossing (conduction angle 25.3 deg); the DC voltage swings between 129.7 V and 141.4 V. The DC side has no connection to gnd while every diode blocks; the blocking resistances hold its potential.
